prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: SEO Research
I need some initial research of key SEO related words. Both search statistics and top suggestions for key words. This is a specific industry and is not large. “Our Product Type” (this will be shared with person that is awarded project ) What will be required: 0) You will create an excel file listing “our product type” and each industry listed below - we will provide sample of first few to make sure this is 100% clear 1) listing of all top searches by industry related to “our product type” 2) key search volumes for all search words 3) recommended SEO terms grouped by key word industry (related to our product type) 4) it is only 1 product word related end to each category There are lots of industries but our related search word will narrows this down a lot for you Software Banking Retail Financial Services Insurance Biotechnology Real Estate Telecommunications Food Energy Restaurants Hotels Apparel Airlines Chemicals Automotive Healthcare Pharmaceuticals Fund Machinery Sports Logistics Metal Semiconductors Holding Consulting Computer Hardware Information Technology & Services Media Recruiting Business Services Oil & Gas Medical Equipment Beverages Maritime Electrical & Electronic Components Internet Utilities Household Products Construction Mining Broadcasting Communication & Sales Engineering & Design Aerospace Accounting Materials Industrial Conglomerates Entertainment & Travel Environmental Services Wholesale Ground Transportation Agriculture Reinsurance Cosmetics Consumer E
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need an initial SEO research file that lists your product type across each industry, with top search terms, search volumes, and recommended SEO terms grouped by industry.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I can help build this in a clear Excel format using careful keyword research and organization. I have 5 years of experience working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, so I’m comfortable turning messy search data into a structured, easy-to-review sheet.

I will make sure the output is organized exactly around your product type and each industry, with the search words grouped logically and the volumes included for each term. I can also match your sample format closely so the scope stays clear and consistent.
